ag1_note.statement: This addendum does NOT close AG-1 and does NOT change ods:scope semantics. It extends the controller-local, additive defense-in-depth guard to cover two further artifacts. Global closure of AG-1 requires separate governed adjudication of scripts/ods-scope.ts and remains explicitly out of scope for this mission and for the successor implementation mission. risks_and_open_findings.R1: TRANSITIONAL COVERAGE WINDOW. Between this artifact's commit and the successor implementation's merge, both v1.0.12 and v1.0.13 exist in the tree while the Controller guard still ends at v1.0.11. ACCEPTED, bounded governed transitional state: CI is green, the guard has no runtime effect, CONTROLLER_DB_EXECUTION is DISABLED, no production promotion occurs, and the interval is precedented by v1.0.10, v1.0.11 and v1.0.12. Mitigation: the successor implementation follows immediately under this authority.
risks_and_open_findings.R2: RECURRING MAINTENANCE COST. Every future ODS maintenance addendum will require its own Controller enumeration cycle, because automatic inclusion is prohibited. This is DELIBERATE, not a defect: the guard's value is exact coverage, and a directory sweep would trade that away. Recorded so a future mission does not 'fix' it by weakening the guard.
risks_and_open_findings.R3: ORDER SENSITIVITY. This authority must not be materialized before the artifact it enumerates exists in integration. That is why the hard gate is stated in anchors.hard_gate and why an earlier invocation of this mission STOPPED rather than proceed against an unmerged PR #56.
risks_and_open_findings.R4: SELF-INCLUSION IS LOAD-BEARING. If the successor implementation ships 22 -> 23 instead of 22 -> 24, the obligation is NOT discharged and a third cycle becomes necessary. Control C1, C2 and C3 exist precisely to make that failure loud.
